note: Labelled retrieval set. 'expect' lists paths that a correct retrieval must surface; a question is a hit when any one of them comes back. Bands: lexical shares words with the target, paraphrase deliberately shares none, conceptual spans several files. The paraphrase band is the one that separates word matching from meaning-based retrieval, so a change to embeddings is judged mostly on that band.
